title: Beautiful Mirrors
statementMd:
Creatnx has $n$ mirrors, numbered from $1$ to $n$. Every day, Creatnx asks exactly one mirror "Am I beautiful?". The $i$-th mirror will tell Creatnx that he is beautiful with probability $\frac{p_i}{100}$ for all $1 \le i \le n$.

Creatnx asks the mirrors one by one, starting from the $1$-st mirror. Every day, if he asks $i$-th mirror, there are two possibilities:

- The $i$-th mirror tells Creatnx that he is beautiful. In this case, if $i = n$ Creatnx will stop and become happy, otherwise he will continue asking the $i+1$-th mirror next day;
- In the other case, Creatnx will feel upset. The next day, Creatnx will start asking from the $1$-st mirror again.

You need to calculate [the expected number](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Expected_value) of days until Creatnx becomes happy.

This number should be found by modulo $998244353$. Formally, let $M = 998244353$. It can be shown that the answer can be expressed as an irreducible fraction $\frac{p}{q}$, where $p$ and $q$ are integers and $q \not \equiv 0 \pmod{M}$. Output the integer equal to $p \cdot q^{-1} \bmod M$. In other words, output such an integer $x$ that $0 \le x \lt M$ and $x \cdot q \equiv p \pmod{M}$.

## Input

The first line contains one integer $n$ ($1\le n\le 2\cdot 10^5$) — the number of mirrors.

The second line contains $n$ integers $p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$ ($1 \leq p_i \leq 100$).

## Output

Print the answer modulo $998244353$ in a single line.

## Note

In the first test, there is only one mirror and it tells, that Creatnx is beautiful with probability $\frac{1}{2}$. So, the expected number of days until Creatnx becomes happy is $2$.
statementZhMd:
Creatnx 有 $n$ 面镜子，编号从 $1$ 到 $n$。每天，Creatnx 会向恰好一面镜子询问“我美丽吗？”。对于所有 $1 \le i \le n$，第 $i$ 面镜子会以概率 $\frac{p_i}{100}$ 告诉 Creatnx 他很美丽。

Creatnx 会依次询问这些镜子，从第 $1$ 面镜子开始。每天，如果他询问第 $i$ 面镜子，会有以下两种情况：

- 第 $i$ 面镜子告诉 Creatnx 他很美丽。在这种情况下，如果 $i = n$，Creatnx 将停止询问并感到开心；否则，他会在第二天继续询问第 $i+1$ 面镜子；
- 否则，Creatnx 会感到沮丧。第二天，Creatnx 将重新从第 $1$ 面镜子开始询问。

请计算 Creatnx 变得开心前的[期望天数](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Expected_value)。

答案需要对 $998244353$ 取模。形式化地，令 $M = 998244353$。可以证明，答案可以表示为最简分数 $\frac{p}{q}$，其中 $p$ 和 $q$ 为整数，且 $q \not \equiv 0 \pmod{M}$。请输出整数 $p \cdot q^{-1} \bmod M$。换句话说，请输出一个满足 $0 \le x \lt M$ 且 $x \cdot q \equiv p \pmod{M}$ 的整数 $x$。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $n$（$1\le n\le 2\cdot 10^5$）——镜子的数量。

第二行包含 $n$ 个整数 $p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$（$1 \leq p_i \leq 100$）。

## 输出格式

在一行中输出对 $998244353$ 取模后的答案。

## 说明

在第一个测试中，只有一面镜子，它以概率 $\frac{1}{2}$ 告诉 Creatnx 他很美丽。因此，Creatnx 变得开心前的期望天数为 $2$。
